def gpx_fields_to_xml(instance: Any, tag: str, version: str,
    custom_attributes: Dict[str, str]={}, nsmap: Dict[str, str]={},
    prettyprint: bool=True, indent: str='', empty_body: bool=False) ->str:
    if instance is None:
        return ''
    
    fields = instance.gpx_10_fields
    if version == '1.1':
        fields = instance.gpx_11_fields
    
    tag_attributes = ''
    if custom_attributes:
        for attr_name, attr_value in custom_attributes.items():
            tag_attributes += f' {attr_name}="{attr_value}"'
    
    body_parts = []
    
    # Stack for tracking open tags
    open_tags = []
    skip_tag = None
    
    child_indent = f'{indent}  ' if prettyprint else ''
    
    for gpx_field in fields:
        if isinstance(gpx_field, str):
            sentinel, fieldname = _check_dependents(instance, gpx_field)
            if fieldname.startswith('/'):
                # Close tag
                actual_tag = fieldname[1:]
                if open_tags and open_tags[-1] == actual_tag:
                    open_tags.pop()
                    skip_tag = None
                    current_indent = f'{indent}{"  " * len(open_tags)}' if prettyprint else ''
                    body_parts.append(f'\n{current_indent}</{actual_tag}>')
            else:
                current_indent = f'{indent}{"  " * (len(open_tags) + 1)}' if prettyprint else ''
                if sentinel:
                    # All dependents are empty, skip this tag
                    skip_tag = fieldname
                    open_tags.append(fieldname)
                else:
                    skip_tag = None
                    open_tags.append(fieldname)
                    body_parts.append(f'\n{current_indent}<{fieldname}>')
        else:
            # It's a field object
            # Check if we're inside a skipped tag
            in_skipped = skip_tag is not None and open_tags and skip_tag in open_tags
            if in_skipped:
                continue
            
            current_indent = f'{indent}{"  " * (len(open_tags) + 1)}' if prettyprint else ''
            
            value = getattr(instance, gpx_field.name)
            if gpx_field.attribute:
                xml_part = gpx_field.to_xml(value, version, nsmap, prettyprint=prettyprint, indent=current_indent)
                if xml_part:
                    tag_attributes += f' {xml_part}'
            else:
                xml_part = gpx_field.to_xml(value, version, nsmap, prettyprint=prettyprint, indent=current_indent)
                if xml_part:
                    body_parts.append(xml_part)
    
    body = ''.join(body_parts)
    
    if not prettyprint:
        indent = ''
    
    if not body and not empty_body:
        return f'\n{indent}<{tag}{tag_attributes} />'
    else:
        return f'\n{indent}<{tag}{tag_attributes}>{body}\n{indent}</{tag}>'
